e.title: insurance-frequency-severity
e.summary: Sarmanov copula 频率-严重度（burning-cost，MIT）：相依结构的联合定价
e.body: insurance-frequency-severity（burning-cost，PyPI，MIT）用 Sarmanov copula 做频率-严重度联合定价：频率与严重度之间的相依结构建模（传统假设二者独立）。对 RIAA：频率-严重度相依的现代方法——[[pycop]]（copula 库）的应用实例：Sarmanov 是计算友好的 copula 族；与 [[tweedie-python]]（分布）、[[insurance-distributional-glm]]（分布 GLM）配套；「独立 vs 相依」的建模选择是定价精度关键；频率-严重度建模（[[rim540]]）的进阶工具。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：burning-cost 仓库 + PyPI 确认（Sarmanov copula 频率-严重度，MIT），未实测
e.summary_en: Sarmanov-copula frequency-severity (burning-cost, MIT): joint pricing with dependence structure
e.summary_hk: Sarmanov copula 頻率-嚴重度（burning-cost，MIT）：相依結構的聯合定價
e.body_en: insurance-frequency-severity (burning-cost, PyPI, MIT) uses the Sarmanov copula for joint frequency-severity pricing: modelling the dependence between frequency and severity (classical models assume independence). For RIAA: a modern method of frequency-severity dependence — an application of [[pycop]] (copula library): Sarmanov is a computation-friendly copula family; with [[tweedie-python]] (distributions) and [[insurance-distributional-glm]] (distributional GLM) it completes the pricing toolkit; the 'independent vs dependent' modelling choice is key to pricing accuracy; an advanced tool of frequency-severity modelling ([[rim540]]).
e.body_hk: insurance-frequency-severity（burning-cost，PyPI，MIT）用 Sarmanov copula 做頻率-嚴重度聯合定價：頻率與嚴重度之間的相依結構建模（傳統假設二者獨立）。對 RIAA：頻率-嚴重度相依的現代方法——[[pycop]]（copula 庫）的應用實例：Sarmanov 是計算友好的 copula 族；與 [[tweedie-python]]（分佈）、[[insurance-distributional-glm]]（分佈 GLM）配套；「獨立 vs 相依」的建模選擇是定價精度關鍵；頻率-嚴重度建模（[[rim540]]）的進階工具。
